description: Manage memory categories. Actions: create, update, delete, list. Categories persist across sessions.

action.description: Action to perform: create, update, delete, or list categories.

color.description: Color hex code, e.g. "#3b82f6". Empty string "" to remove.

description.description: Category description (required for create, optional for update).

format.description: Output format for list action: flat, tree (default), or parents-only.

is_parent.description: Make this a parent/cluster category (create only).

parent.description: Parent category name. Empty string "" to remove parent.

reassign_children_to.description: Reassign child categories to this parent when deleting a parent. Empty string "" for top-level (delete only).

reassign_to.description: Reassign memories to this category before deleting (delete only).

name: category
